title: pi-replay session
description: A condensed, authored summary of a real coding-agent (Pi) session, replayed as an animated terminal by hugo-pi-replay. See AGENTS.md for authoring rules. The golden rule: every result, number and string must come from the real session — condense, never fabricate.

cwd.description: Working directory label shown in the terminal header, e.g. '~/Dev/blog (main)'.

model.description: Model label shown in the terminal header, e.g. 'claude-opus-5-5 • medium'.

prompt.description: The user's request, verbatim. Typed character by character (18ms/char).

intro.description: One or two sentences: what the agent is about to do. Typed word by word (35ms/word). Keep it short.

script.description: Syntax-highlighted codemode script, streamed into the editor at ~0.9 chars/ms. Concatenating all token texts must yield valid JavaScript.

prefixItems.description: Token class: k keyword, f function, s string, n number, c comment, p punctuation, '' plain.

calls.description: Nested tool calls made while the script ran, sorted by start time. Calls whose t+d exceeds ~2.5s of replay time are fast-forwarded; keep the earliest ones at real speed and sample the rest.

t.description: Start time in ms, relative to the start of the codemode run (script begins typing at t=0). Monotonically increasing.

d.description: Duration in ms. A check mark appears when simulated time reaches t+d.

name.description: Tool name exactly as the real session recorded it, e.g. 'mcp__linear__list_issues'.

args.description: Compact one-line rendering of the arguments, e.g. '{ team:
}'. Truncated by ellipsis if too long — keep it short.

wallMs.description: Total wall-clock duration of the codemode run in ms; must be >= every call's t+d. After this the tool box closes.

output.description: Final output/return value of the tool run, shown verbatim (JSON pretty-printed is typical).

answer.description: 1-4 authored answer blocks, minimal inline HTML only: <b>, <code>, <em>. Each block is ["p", html] or ["ul", [item, item, ...]].
